name: Nerd Corruption
source:
You take the role of a less than good looking man. A man who is painfully aware that his future won't involve any beautiful women.
But after visiting your new friend you make an amazing discovery. You've stumbled upon a golden ticket.
Suddenly you never want to leave his home ever again.​
translation:
你扮演一个不太好看的男人的角色。一个痛苦地意识到他的未来不会有任何美女的男人。
但在拜访了你的新朋友之后，你有了一个惊人的发现。你偶然发现了一张金票。
突然间你再也不想离开他的家了。​
